title: leucas montana var. angustifolia
intro: Leucas montana var. angustifolia, commonly known as Narrow-leaved Leucas, is a plant species belonging to the family Lamiaceae. This plant has been traditionally used in folk medicine for its various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Leucas montana var. angustifolia include treating fever, cough, and respiratory issues, as well as providing relief from wounds and skin infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
